title: Sabha gold transcript
description: One human-annotated recording, written by eval/goldset/export_gold.py to eval/goldset/gold/<recording_id>.json. Two rules JSON Schema cannot express are enforced by export_gold.check_transcript: every segment has start_ms < end_ms, and segments are sorted by (start_ms, end_ms, speaker_role). Segments of different speakers may overlap in time.

recording_id.description: Audio file name without its extension.

consent_ref.description: Reference to the consent record for this recording. Never empty.

annotator.description: Label Studio user id of the annotator as 'ls-user-<id>' (no names or emails).

annotation_id.description: Label Studio annotation id the segments came from.

exported_at.description: When export_gold.py wrote this file, UTC, ISO 8601.

start_ms.description: Start on the original recording timeline, integer milliseconds.

end_ms.description: End on the original recording timeline, integer milliseconds; greater than start_ms.

text.description: Verbatim transcript (docs/annotation-guidelines.md). Empty for silence and only for silence.
